name: plain frontmatter
why: It is split off and never reaches the body. Its opening --- must NOT become the document's first <hr>.

name: closed with three dots
why: YAML accepts ... as a document terminator.

name: a list is flattened
why: A list is only usable in a footer if it is a single line of text.

name: quotes are stripped
why: A quoted value is used verbatim in the footer, without the quotes.

name: unterminated is NOT frontmatter
why: Inventing the closing delimiter would swallow real document content.

name: a document without frontmatter is untouched
why: A --- in the middle is an ordinary thematic break and must stay one.

name: --- past the first line does not open frontmatter
why: Frontmatter only exists when it starts on the very first line.

name: nested keys are skipped without failing
why: Odd frontmatter must never stop a document from being exported.

name: comments and blank lines are skipped
why: They are valid YAML and they are not fields.
